Glessner House, 1800 South Prairie Avenue, Chicago, 1965. HABS IL-1015 photograph 13 of 17 (call number HABS ILL,16-CHIG,17--13). Library of Congress.
author: Perry E. Borchers (HABS)
repository: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division (HABS). Master TIFF 060915pu.tif in the owner's Internet Archive item master-pnp-habshaer-il-il0100-il0118-photos; 1800 px web copy committed at chicago/prairie_1904_v1/research/public/glessner-habs-photo-13.jpg (Prairie library source pa-glessner-habs-photo-13, PR #169).
locator: The whole plate: the east wing's 18th Street (north) face from the NE corner to the junction with the north range.
rights_note: Made for HABS (U.S. Government); LOC: no known restrictions. Measurements only; nothing derived as an asset.
access_notes: Viewed 2026-09-28 (T-1732) from the committed web copy; scaled against the 26'-6" gable (about 34 px/ft).
note: A 1965 photogrammetric plate of the kind sheet 6 was drawn from. It shows the east wing's north face (paired second-floor windows, two first-floor slit windows) and, at its top right, the curved rock-faced drum of the round tower at the junction with the north range.
what_it_supplies: a second first-floor window in the east wing's north face (about W 17.6-19.0)
the round, stone form of the north tower's drum
what_it_does_not_supply: heights above the frame's top edge
the 1904 state of anything the 1946 list names
